title: Tomato Bisque
text:
Serves: 4
Prep time: 20 minutes
Cook time: 40 minutes
Soup
If you liked the last one, you’ll love this!

title: Tomato Bisque
text:
Ingredients

6 tbsp butter
1 tbsp olive oil
1 medium onion, diced
1 carrot, diced
1 stick of celery, diced
1 red bell pepper, diced
3 cloves of garlic, diced
1 can of San Marzano crushed tomatoes (28 oz)
chicken stock (to desired thickness)
1 cup heavy cream
½ cup sherry (optional)
1 tsp black pepper
salt to taste
sugar to taste
basil (chiffonade)
½ cup balsamic vinegar

title: Tomato Bisque
text:
Instructions

Add the butter and oil to a sauté pan.
Sauté (with a pinch of salt) the onion, carrot, celery, and bell pepper on medium-high heat until the onions are translucent.
Add the garlic and cook for an additional 30 seconds.
De-glaze the pan with the sherry (or chicken stock).
Add the tomatoes and chicken stock and bring to a simmer.
Add the black pepper and sugar until the desired taste is reached.
Simmer for >30 min.
Transfer to a blender and blend on high until completely smooth.
Transfer back to the sauté pan and add in the heavy cream.
Add the balsamic vinegar to a non-stick pan on medium heat to make a reduction.
Serve with the chiffonade basil and the balsamic reduction.

title: Chicken Noodle Soup
text:
Serves: 4
Prep time: 15 minutes
Cook time: 45 minutes
Soup
Cure your cold with this one.

title: Chicken Noodle Soup
text:
Ingredients

1 tbsp olive olive
1 tbsp butter
1 yellow onion (diced)
3 celery stalks (diced)
2 carrots (thin sliced or chopped)
6 garlic cloves
12 cups chicken broth
4 thyme sprigs
2 bay leaves
2 lbs chicken breast
salt (to taste)
black pepper (to taste)
egg noodles

title: Chicken Noodle Soup
text:
Instructions

Heat the butter and oil in a Dutch oven.
Add onions, carrots and celery. Cook for 5 minutes then stir in the garlic.
Pour in your chicken broth and add in your thyme and bay leaves bring to a simmer.
Add your chicken and let cook for 25–30 minutes or until chicken is fully cooked.
Take chicken out and cut it into pieces.
Add egg noodles to the broth and cook for 7 minutes.
Take out the sprigs and bay leaves and add back in your chicken with your noodles.
Add salt and pepper to taste and enjoy.

title: Chicken & Dumplings
text:
Ingredients

3–4 chicken breasts
1 medium onion (diced)
2 stalks of celery (chopped)
3–4 carrots (sliced or diced)
2 cans cream of chicken soup
1 box chicken broth
3 tbsp butter
garlic powder
parsley
poultry seasoning
black pepper
1 cup half & half
1 can Pillsbury® buttermilk biscuits

title: Chicken & Dumplings
text:
Instructions

Place chicken in the crock-pot.
Stir together all other ingredients except for the half & half and biscuits and pour over the chicken.
Cook on low for 7–8 hours.
Take out the chicken and pull apart.
Cut the raw biscuits into small ¾″ pieces and place in the crock-pot.
Add the half & half. You can add how ever much you want.
Put the chicken back in and cook on high for another hour.

title: Onion Rings
text:
Serves: 3
Prep time: 30 minutes
Cook time: 5 minutes
Side Vegetarian
You probably weren’t expecting onion rings in this book.

title: Onion Rings
text:
Ingredients

Onion Marinade

2 onions (ringed)
1 cup water
1 cup whole milk



Batter

1⅓ cup flour
1 tbsp shortening
2 eggs (separated)
¾ cup water
1 tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper

title: Onion Rings
text:
Instructions
Preheat frying oil to 375°F.

Combine the water and whole milk for the marinade, and add the onions to the mixture. Marinate for $geq$30 minutes.
Beat the egg yolks until smooth and the egg whites until stiff. These are done SEPARATELY!
Mix the yolks, flour, shortening, water, salt, and black pepper.
Fold in the egg whites.
Dip the onion rings in the batter, and fry until golden brown.

text:
Instructions

title: Jalapeño Jelly

title: Western Burgers
text:
Serves: 4
Prep time: 30 minutes
Cook time: 15 minutes
Main
These are a favorite from school cafeterias in the 70s–80s Created by a cafeteria worker named Emaline Anderson in Wichita Falls, TX.

title: Western Burgers
text:
Ingredients

Dough

4 cups flour
4 tbsp shortening
1 tsp salt
4 tbsp sugar
1½–2 cups hot water
3 (¼ oz) packages Quick Rise Yeast



Meat

1–1½ lbs ground beef
½ onion (chopped)
¼ cup mustard
½ cup mayonnaise
1 cup cheese (American, velveeta, etc., NOT cheddar)
salt and black pepper (to taste)

title: Western Burgers
text:
Instructions
Preheat the oven to 350°F.

Dough

Mix four, salt, sugar, and yeast. Mix well.
Add shortening and mix until crumbly.
Add hot water a little at a time until a soft ball forms.
While the dough is rising, make the meat mixture.



Burgers

Brown meat over medium-high heat and drain.
Add remaining ingredients and mix well.
Roll dough into balls on lightly floured surface.
Flatten dough (not too thin).
Place ~⅓ cup of the meat in the middle of each flattened ball.
Bring the dough up around the meat and pinch together.
Turn over and flatten with hand.
Place on an un-creased cookie sheet and bake until golden brown (about 12 minutes).

title: Spaghetti & Meatballs
text:
Serves: 4 Prep time: 30 minutes Cook time: 30 minutes
Main
A more classic use of spaghetti.

title: Spaghetti & Meatballs
text:
Ingredients



Meatballs

¼ lb chopped mortadella
1 lb ground beef
1 tsp (2g) finely ground fennel
1¾ tsp (12g) fine sea salt
3 cloves garlic (diced)
¼ cup (20g) grated parmesan
black pepper to taste
½ cup (35g) bread crumbs
1 whole egg




Sauce

¼ cup extra virgin olive oil
4 cloves garlic, thinly sliced
1 tsp (2g) red pepper flakes
1 can peeled tomatoes (28 oz)
1 bunch of basil
grated parmesan for serving
chiffonade basil for serving
1 package spaghetti

title: Spaghetti & Meatballs
text:
Instructions
Prepare the meatballs before making the sauce.

In a bowl, place your chopped mortadella, combine it with the ground beef, fennel seed, salt, garlic, parmesan cheese, and black pepper, mix it well, and add the panko and eggs and mix again until emulsified and tacky.
Use a large cookie scoop to make the meatballs, around twenty, place them on a sheet tray and roll them into balls.
In a large sautée pan, over medium-high, pour enough olive oil to cover the bottom of the pan; once the oil is hot, add all the meatballs in one single layer, and sear for about two minutes, flip and sear one or two more sides, until golden brown (it’s okay if there are not cooked all the way).
Remove the meatballs from the pan and reserve.
In the same pan where the meatballs were cooked, reduce the heat to medium, add the garlic, and sauté for about 5 minutes.
Add the pepper flakes, sauté for thirty seconds and add your crushed tomatoes.
Stir in a pinch of sugar (or to desired sweetness).
Add the meatballs back into the pan, bring to a simmer, and reduce the heat to medium-low and simmer for five to eight minutes.
Halfway through this process, add the basil leaves and let simmer until the meatballs cook all the way through.
Place spaghetti in a pot of boiling water that has been seasoned generously with salt.
Cook according to package instructions or until done.
Using tongs, pick up the pasta, let it drain slightly, add it to your sauce until all your pasta has been added.
Place one portion of pasta in a shallow bowl, pour some sauce on top and two or three meatballs, grate some fresh parmesan, and finally, some chiffonade fresh basil.

Instructions

title: Mojo Pulled Pork
text:
Serves: 4
Prep time: 20 minutes
Cook time: 3½–4 hours
Main
Make this for every party you throw.

title: Mojo Pulled Pork
text:
Ingredients

1 pork shoulder
Chicken stock (if needed)
Kosher salt (to taste)
1 onion (quartered)
2 heads of garlic (peeled)
2 oranges (juice and zest)
3 limes (juice and zest)
2 tbsp (7g) oregano leaves
½ bunch of mint leaves
1 tbsp (5g) ground cumin
2 serrano chilies
1 cup extra virgin olive oil
1½ tbsp kosher salt
1 cup fresh lime juice
1 cup fresh orange juice or pineapple juice

title: Mojo Pulled Pork
text:
Instructions
Marinate overnight; Preheat the oven to 400°F on day of cooking.

In a blender, add the onion, garlic, orange zest, lime zest, oregano leaves, mint leaves, cumin, serrano peppers, olive oil, salt, lime juice, and orange juice.
Blend together on high speed until completely smooth.
Reserve 1 cup of the marinade to use for dipping.
With a paring knife, poke deep holes all over the pork shoulder.
In a large resealable bag, place the pork shoulder, and pour in the remaining mojo marinade to cover the meat. Seal the bag and marinate in the refrigerator overnight.
Remove the pork from the marinade and place in a dutch oven.
Pour in all of the marinade. The marinade should come about halfway up the pot, but if not, add a little bit of chicken stock.
Braise the pork, uncovered, for 20 minutes. Then reduce the temperature to 350°F and cook until the internal temperature of the pork is 200°F ($~$3½–4 hours) flipping occasionally.
Remove the pork from the dutch oven and place on a cutting board to cool.
In a large bowl, using two forks, shred the meat.
Toss together using the braising liquid to coat the meat to your desired level of fattiness.
Season to taste with salt.

title: Lemon Garlic Shrimp Pasta
text:

Main

title: Lemon Garlic Shrimp Pasta
text:
Ingredients

1 lemon (juice)
1 tbsp minced garlic (or 4 garlic cloves)
2 tbsp butter (for sautéing)
4 tbsp butter (for sauce)
2 tbsp water
pasta of choice
salt (to taste)
black pepper (to taste)

title: Lemon Garlic Shrimp Pasta
text:
Instructions

Melt 2 tbsp butter in a large skillet on medium-high heat.
Add the garlic and cook for about 1 minute.
Fry the shrimp, cooking for 2 minutes on each side.
Add salt and pepper to taste and stir occasionally.
Add in the remaining butter, lemon juice, and water.
Cook until the butter melts and the shrimp have cooked fully.
Take off heat, add more salt and pepper if needed, and serve on your preferred pasta.

title: Ground Beef Bulgogi

1 tbsp + 2 tsp brown sugar
2 tsp sesame oil
1 tsp ginger (minced)
1 tsp garlic (minced)



Ground Beef

1 lb ground beef
½ yellow onion (diced)



Toppings

1 tbsp scallion (diced)
1 tsp sesame seeds
4 large soft boiled eggs

title: Ground Beef Bulgogi
text:
Instructions
Prepare the meatballs before making the sauce.

In a medium bowl combine the ingredients for the bulgogi sauce.
Mix well to combine and set aside.
In a skillet over medium-high heat, add ground beef and onion and cook until browned (about 5 minutes). The meat will still be a little pink.
Add the bulgogi sauce and mix well.
Simmer for 6–10 more minutes, and remove from heat.
Serve on top of rice.
Top with scallions, toasted sesame seeds, and a soft boiled egg.

title: Fettuccine Alfredo
text:
Serves: 4
Prep time: 5 minutes
Cook time: 25 minutes
Main
It slaps.

title: Fettuccine Alfredo
text:
Ingredients

½ cup butter
1 ½ cup heavy whipping cream

½ tsp italian seasoning

1 lb chicken breast or shrimp

title: Fettuccine Alfredo
text:
Instructions

Add butter and cream to a large skillet.
Simmer over low for 2 minutes.
Whisk in garlic and seasonings for one minute.
Whisk in parmesan until melted.
Mix in with noodles and your choice of chicken or shrimp.

title: Chili 2.0
text:
Serves: 4
Prep time: 5 minutes
Cook time: 2–4 hours
Main
Gage’s rendition on Boss’ chili.

title: Chili 2.0
text:
Ingredients

1 tbsp peanut oil
1 lb ground beef
1 lb breakfast sausage
4 strips of bacon sliced
1 onion finely diced
3 garlic cloves crushed
3 jalapeños finely diced
¼ cup flour
⅓ cup red wine (optional)
1 large can crushed tomatoes
≥3 tbsp chili powder
1 tbsp pepper
1 tbsp cumin
1 tbsp garlic powder
1 tsp paprika
¼ tsp coriander
2 tsp rosemary
Salt (to taste)
2 cups water

title: Chili 2.0
text:
Instructions

In a large pot, add the oil and heat over high until shimmering.
Add the bacon and cook until lightly browned.
Add the beef and breakfast sausage.
Cook over high until browned.
Remove the meat and add the onions and jalapeños.
Cook until translucent.
Add the flour and thoroughly mix.
Cook until lightly browned.
Add the garlic, and continue to mix for another 30 sec.
De-glaze with the wine or beef stock, then add the crushed tomatoes and all the spices.
Mix thoroughly, and add water to desired thickness.
Cover, reduce heat to low, and simmer for 2–4 hours.

title: Chicken Tacos
text:

title: Chicken Tacos

Sprinkle chicken taco seasoning packet over all the chicken.
Pour in salsa, corn, and green chiles.
Cook on high for 4 hours, or low for 6 hours.

title: Chicken Katsu
text:
Serves: 4
Prep time: 20 minutes
Cook time: 15 minutes
Main
It’s fried chicken my boy.

title: Chicken Katsu
text:
Ingredients

1½ cups all-purpose flour
3 large eggs
2 tbsp water
2 cups panko
4 boneless, skinless chicken breasts/thighs
2 cups high-heat oil
kosher salt

title: Chicken Katsu
text:
Instructions

Place the chicken breasts between two pieces of plastic wrap and pound to an even thickness of ~½″. Season with salt.
Prepare 3 separate shallow bowls for the breading station. In the first, place the flour. In the second, whisk together the eggs and water. In the last, place the panko.
Thoroughly coat each piece of chicken in the flour, shaking off any excess.
Coat evenly in the egg, making sure no dry spots remain.
Finally, coat the chicken on all sides in the panko, pressing to make sure it’s thoroughly coated.
Set aside on a piece of parchment paper, and separate each breast with a new layer of parchment.
Fill a large deep cast-iron skillet or heavy-bottomed pot with the oil, and heat over high heat until just shimmering, or about 325–350°F.
Carefully place the chicken breast in the oil one at a time.
Fry for 3–5 minutes, or until crispy golden brown.
Flip and fry for an additional 3–5 minutes, or until it reaches an internal temp of 165°F.
Place on a wire rack in a rimmed baking sheet, season again with salt and let drain and cool.
Repeat with the remaining chicken breasts.
Serve sliced, with a side of spicy cabbage slaw, and drizzled with katsu sauce and Sriracha.

Add the soy sauce, citrus, garlic, cilantro, and seasonings, and mix together to fully coat the steak.

title: Browned Butter Brownies
text:
Serves: 4
Prep time: 30 minutes
Cook time: 30 minutes

It has coffee, so eat it for the energy.

title: Browned Butter Brownies
text:
Ingredients

1½ sticks unsalted butter
4 oz (113 grams) semisweet chocolate (chopped)
½ cup (100 grams) sugar
½ cup (100 grams) light brown sugar
3 large eggs
1 tsp vanilla extract
½ cup (64 grams) all-purpose flour
½ cup (43 grams) unsweetened cocoa powder
½ teaspoon instant espresso powder
½ teaspoon fine salt
1 cup (170 grams) semisweet chocolate chips

title: Browned Butter Brownies
text:
Instructions
Preheat the oven to 350°F.

Grease a glass 8″ square pan.
In a small saucepan set over medium low heat, melt the butter.
Swirling the pan occasionally, continue to cook the butter, increasing the heat to medium. It should become foamy with audible crackling and popping noises.
Once the crackling stops, continue to swirl the pan until the butter develops a nutty aroma and brown bits start to form at the bottom. Do not allow the bits to burn!
Once the bits are amber in color, (~2–3 minutes after the popping stops) remove from heat and pour into a mixing bowl, scraping the brown bits into the bowl.
Quickly add in the chopped chocolate and stir until melted.
In the bowl of an electric mixer fitted with the whisk attachment, combine the sugar, brown sugar, eggs, and vanilla.
Beat on high speed until completely thickened and fluffy in texture and lightened in color, ~8 minutes.
On low speed, gradually pour in the butter/chocolate mixture.
Using a rubber spatula, fold in the flour, cocoa, espresso, and salt until just combined.
Fold in the chocolate chips.
Pour into the prepared pan and smooth out with a spatula.
Bake for 22–25 minutes, or until set but not overbaked.
Let cool completely before slicing and serving.

title: Dinner Rolls
text:
Serves: 9
Prep time: 2½ hours
Cook time: 20–30 minutes

Don’t think about the carbs. Think about your taste buds.

title: Dinner Rolls
text:
Ingredients

Dough

½ cup whole milk (100°F)
½ cup water (100°F)
2½ tsp instant dry yeast
3½ cups bread flour
1 tbsp granulated sugar
1½ tsp fine salt
1 large egg
1 large egg yolk
2½ tbsp unsalted butter (softened)



Milk Roux

2 tbsp all-purpose flour
2 tbsp filtered water
¼ cup whole milk



For Baking

1 egg (beaten)
⅓ cup salted butter
2 cloves garlic (minced)
flaky salt

title: Dinner Rolls
text:
Instructions
Preheat the oven to 375°F.

Milk Roux

In a small saucepan, whisk together the flour, water, and milk until completely dissolved.
Heat over medium heat, stirring continuously, until the mixture thickens into a thick paste.
Transfer to a small bowl and set aside to cool.



Dough

In a bowl, add the warmed milk and water. Stir in the yeast, cover with plastic wrap, and set aside for 10 minutes.
In the bowl of a stand mixer, whisk together the bread flour, sugar, and salt until thoroughly combined.
Fit the stand mixer with the dough hook and mix on medium-low speed.
One at a time, add the yeast mixture, whole egg, and egg yolk.
Once the mixture starts to come together, add the milk roux.
Mix for 3–4 minutes or until the dough is smooth.
Add the butter and continue mixing on medium-low speed until all the butter is incorporated.
Transfer the dough to a large greased bowl and cover with greased plastic wrap.
Let rise at room temperature for 1½ hours or until the dough has doubled in size.
Punch down the dough to release the gas and turn onto your working surface.



Baking

Lightly grease an 8″ square baking pan. Divide the dough into 9 even pieces. Shape each piece into a tight ball by stretching and folding the sides over into the center of the dough.
Roll the dough ball in circles while maintaining constant contact with the work surface until you’ve formed a tight ball.
In the baking pan, arrange the dough balls in rows of 3. Cover with a damp towel and let proof at room temperature for 30 minutes or until doubled in size.
Brush the proofed rolls with the egg to lightly coat each top.
Bake for 30 minutes or until puffed and golden brown.
When they’re almost done baking, in a small pot, gently heat the butter over medium heat until melted.
Add the garlic and gently swirl for 10 seconds.
Remove the rolls from the oven and immediately brush with the garlic butter, sprinkle with the flaky salt, and serve warm for the best texture and flavor.

Perfect for making Cubano sandwiches.

title: Cubano Bread
text:
Ingredients

1¼ cups water (100°F)
1 tbsp instant dry yeast
3½ cups (500g) unbleached bread flour
1 tbsp (13g) granulated sugar
2 tsp (12g) fine sea salt
2½ tbsp lard, solidified

title: Cubano Bread
text:
Instructions
Preheat the oven to 400°F.

In a small bowl, stir together the warm water and yeast. Cover with plastic wrap and let sit for 10 min. The mixture should get slightly foamy, and the yeast should dissolve.
In a stand mixer bowl, add the flour, sugar, and salt. Mix together thoroughly. With the dough hook attachment, start mixing on medium-low speed. Slowly add the warm yeast mixture and the lard. Mix until combined. Once a cohesive dough is formed, keep mixing for another 3 to 5 minutes, or until smooth.
Shape the dough into a ball, and place in a greased bowl covered with greased plastic wrap. Let rise at room temp for 45 min to 1 hr, or until doubled in size.
Punch down the dough to release the gas and place on a lightly floured surface. Divide the dough into 2 even pieces. Cover with a damp towel, and let them rest right where they are for 10 minutes.
Flatten out 1 piece of dough into about a ½-inch thick rectangle, with the long edge ~10″ long.
From the long edge, tightly roll the dough and close the seams at the bottom and sides.
Carefully roll the log while applying pressure outward to slightly taper the ends. The log should be ~15″ long.
Repeat with the other piece of dough.
Place the loaves onto a parchment-lined baking sheet 4–6″ apart. Cover with another baking sheet.
Let the dough proof for >30 minutes at room temperature.
About 10 minutes before the dough is done proofing, bring a 10″ oven-proof skillet of water to a boil.
Using a spray bottle, lightly spray the dough with water.
Using a razor blade or an extremely sharp knife, score a shallow seam along the length of the loaves.
Place the skillet of boiling water on the bottom rack of the oven.
Place the baking sheet with the dough in the middle of the oven on a separate rack above the water.
Spray the inside of the oven with a little water to generate steam.
Let the bread steam for 8–10 minutes. Reduce the heat to 375°F, remove the skillet of water, and let the bread bake for another 20–22 minutes, or until lightly browned.
Let cool completely on a wire rack. Slice and serve. Store on the counter loosely wrapped in a kitchen towel for up to 2 days and then in a resealable bag for 1 more day. Freeze in an airtight container for up to 2 months.

title: Zucchini Bread
text:
Serves: 8
Prep time: 15 minutes
Cook time: 1 hour
Bread Vegetarian
The kids will love this as long as you don’t tell them it has zucchini in it.

title: Zucchini Bread
text:
Ingredients

3 eggs
2 sticks butter (melted)
2 cups sugar
2 cups zucchini (grated)
2 tsp vanilla extract
3 cups all purpose flour
3 tsp ground cinnamon
1 tsp baking soda
¼ tsp baking powder
1 tsp salt
½ cup walnuts (chopped, optional)

title: Zucchini Bread
text:
Instructions
Preheat the oven to 325°F.

Grease and flour two 8×4″ loaf pans.
In a bowl, beat eggs until light and frothy.
Mix in oil and sugar.
Stir in zucchini and vanilla.
Combine flour, cinnamon, baking soda, baking powder, salt, and walnuts.
Stir into egg mixture.
Divide batter into pans evenly and bake for 60–70 minutes.

title: Buttermilk Pancakes
text:
Serves: 4
Prep time: 5 minutes
Cook time: 15 minutes
Breakfast Vegetarian
Make these every Christmas morning.

title: Buttermilk Pancakes
text:
Ingredients

2 eggs, separated
2 cups buttermilk
2 cups flour
¼ tsp salt
½ cup sugar
3 tsp baking powder
¼ tsp baking soda
2 tbsp vegetable oil
1 tsp vanilla

title: Buttermilk Pancakes
text:
Instructions

Separate eggs, beat egg whites until stiff, and set aside.
Mix egg yolks with buttermilk.
Mix dry ingredients and oil.
Add egg yolks and buttermilk to the dry mixture. Mix well.
Stir in vanilla.
Fold in the egg whites.
Cook on medium-high griddle.

title: Apple Pie
text:
Serves: 8–10
Prep time: 15 minutes
Cook time: 1 hour
Dessert Vegetarian
A is for apple…America’s first choice in pie.

title: Apple Pie
text:
Ingredients

For 9″ pie

¾–1 cup sugar
1 tsp cinnamon or nutmeg
6–7 cups apples (sliced, pared)
1½ tbsp butter (melted)



For 8″ pie

½–¾ cup sugar
¾ tsp cinnamon or nutmeg
4–5 cups apples (sliced, pared)
1 tbsp butter (melted)

title: Apple Pie
text:
Instructions
Preheat the oven to 425°F.

Mix the sugar and cinnamon/nutmeg.
Mix lightly through the apples.
Heat up in pastry-lined pie pan.
Dot with butter.
Cover with top crust which has slits cut in it.
Seal and flute.
Cover edge with a strip of aluminum foil to prevent excessive browning.
Bake 50–60 minutes, or until crust is nicely browned and apples are cooked through (test with a fork).
Serve warm or cold with a heaping scoop of vanilla ice cream.

title: Best-Ever Lemon Pie
text:
Serves: 8–10
Prep time: 15 minutes
Cook time: 30–40 minutes
Dessert Vegetarian
It really is the best ever.

title: Best-Ever Lemon Pie
text:
Ingredients

1 baked 9″ pie shell
1¼ cups sugar
6 tbsp cornstarch
2 cups water
⅓ cup lemon juice
3 eggs (separated)
3 tbsp butter
1½ tsp lemon extract
2 tsp vinegar

title: Best-Ever Lemon Pie
text:
Instructions
Preheat the oven to 350°F or use a blowtorch. Top with Never-Fail Meringue.

Mix the sugar and cornstarch together in a double boiler, then add the water.
Combine the egg yolks and lemon juice and beat until smooth.
Slowly add to the rest of the mixture, making sure not to curdle the eggs.
Cook until thick over boiling water for 25 minutes.
Add the lemon extract, butter, and vinegar and stir thoroughly.
Pour into a deep, 9″ pie shell and let cool to room temperature.
Cover with meringue and brown in the oven or with a blowtorch.

title: Buttermilk Pie
text:
Serves: 8–10
Prep time: 15 minutes
Cook time: 45 minutes
Dessert Vegetarian
Just because it was devised in the Depression doesn’t mean it isn’t delicious!

title: Buttermilk Pie
text:
Ingredients

3 eggs
1½ cups sugar
1 tbsp flour
6 tsp butter (melted)
1 tsp lemon extract
½ cup buttermilk
dash of salt
ground cinnamon
ground nutmeg

title: Buttermilk Pie
text:
Instructions
Preheat the oven to 350°F.

Beat the eggs and add the sugar, flour, butter, salt, and lemon extract.
Add the buttermilk to the mixture and mix.
Pour the mixture into an uncooked pie shell.
Dust the top of the pie with cinnamon and nutmeg.
Bake for 45 minutes.

title: Créme Brûlée
text:
Serves: 4
Prep time: 20 minutes
Cook time: 30–60 minutes
Dessert Vegetarian
There’s something wrong with you if you don’t like this dish.

title: Créme Brûlée
text:
Ingredients

2 cups heavy cream
5 egg yolks
½ cup granulated sugar
1 tsp vanilla extract
¼ tsp kosher salt
sugar for topping
Fruit of choice for topping

title: Créme Brûlée
text:
Instructions
Preheat oven the to 325°F. A torch will work better than a broiler for caramelizing the sugar topping.

In a saucepan, combine cream, vanilla bean, and salt, and cook over low heat just until beginning to steam. Let sit for 5–10 minutes.
In a bowl, beat yolks and sugar together until light.
Stir about a quarter of the cream into this mixture, then pour sugar-egg mixture into cream and stir.
Pour into four 6-ounce ramekins and place ramekins in a baking dish
Fill dish with water halfway up the sides of the dishes.
Bake for 30 min to 1 hour, or until centers are barely set.
Cool completely. Refrigerate for several hours or up to two days.
When ready to serve, top each custard with about a teaspoon of sugar in a thin layer.
Place ramekins in a broiler 2–3″ from heat source.
Turn on the broiler and cook until the sugar melts and browns or even blackens a bit, about 5 minutes.
Serve within two hours.

title: Fruit Tarts
text:
Serves: 8
Prep time: 10 minutes
Cook time: 30 minutes
Dessert Vegetarian
Don’t let his age fool you. Sawyer makes a mean dessert!

title: Fruit Tarts
text:
Ingredients

2 rolls sugar cookie dough
½–⅔ cup preferred jam

title: Fruit Tarts
text:
Instructions
Preheat the oven to 350°F.

Spread 1 cookie dough roll out on a baking pan.
Spread the jam thoroughly over the dough.
Place the other roll of cookie dough over the top.
Bake according to the dough’s manufacturer’s specifications.

title: Key Lime Ice Cream
text:
Serves: 8
Prep time: 5 minutes
Dessert Vegetarian
Sometimes making a pie is too much effort.

title: Key Lime Ice Cream
text:
Ingredients

2 eggs
1 can Eagle Brand condensed milk
2 cups half & half
2 limes (zest and juice)
1 tbsp vanilla extract

title: Key Lime Ice Cream
text:
Instructions

Mix all the ingredients together.
Add the mixture into the ice cream maker.
Mix to desired consistency.

title: Never-Fail Meringue
text:
Serves: 8–10
Prep time: 15 minutes
Cook time: 20 minutes
Dessert Vegetarian
It hasn’t failed me yet! Great for topping pies.

title: Never-Fail Meringue
text:
Ingredients

1 tbsp cornstarch
2 tbsp cold water
½ cup boiling water
3 egg whites
6 tbsp sugar
1 tsp vanilla extract
pinch of salt

title: Never-Fail Meringue
text:
Instructions

Blend the cornstarch and cold water in a saucepan.
Add boiling water and cook until clear and thickened.
Let stand until COMPLETELY cold.
With an electric beater at high speed, beat the egg whites until foamy.
Gradually add sugar and beat until STIFF, but not dry.
Turn mixer to low and add the salt and vanilla.
Gradually beat in the cold cornstarch mixture.
Turn mixer again to high speed and beat well.

title: Popcorn Balls
text:
Serves: 12–15
Prep time: 15 minutes
Cook time: 10 minutes
Dessert Vegetarian
Make into interesting shapes for kiddies.

title: Popcorn Balls
text:
Ingredients

7 cups popped corn
1 cup sugar
⅓ cup water
⅓ cup corn syrup
1 tsp salt
¼ cup butter
1 tsp vanilla extract

title: Popcorn Balls
text:
Instructions
Preheat the oven to 375°F

Put popped corn in a large bowl.
Mix the sugar, water, syrup, salt, and butter in a saucepan.
Cook to 250°F or until a few drops form a hard ball when dropped into cold water.
Remove from heat and add in the vanilla.
Pour in a thin stream over the popped corn while stirring constantly to mix well.
Shape the mixture into balls or whatever shape you like.

title: Sopapilla Cheesecake
text:
Serves: 4
Prep time: 30 minutes
Cook time: 1 hour
Dessert Vegetarian
The most addicting thing ever devised.

title: Sopapilla Cheesecake
text:
Ingredients

2 packages cream cheese (softened)
1¼ sticks butter (softened, divided)
1½ cups sugar (divided)
2 tsp vanilla (divided)
2 packages Pillsbury® crescent rolls
½ tsp ground cinnamon

title: Sopapilla Cheesecake
text:
Instructions
Preheat the oven to 350°F.

Grease a 13×9″ pan and set aside.
Combine cream cheese and 4 tbsp butter in large bowl.
Beat until mixture is creamy.
Gradually beat in 1 cup of sugar and 1 tsp vanilla.
Unroll the package of crescent rolls and lay in the prepared pan (do not separate the rolls).
Stretch the dough to the edges of the pan and seal the perforations.
Spread the cream cheese mixture evenly over the dough.
Place the remaining package of crescent rolls on the top of the cream cheese mixture.
Pinch the dough together at the perforations to seal.
Melt the remaining 6 tbsp butter.
Stir in the remaining sugar and vanilla as well as the cinnamon.
Pour mixture evenly over dough.
Bake for 30 minutes or until the cheesecake is slightly puffed and golden brown.

title: Strawberry Cheesecake
text:
Serves: 8–12
Prep time: 15 minutes
Cook time: 45 minutes
Dessert Vegetarian
The best way to improve a cheesecake is to make it a strawberry cheesecake.

title: Strawberry Cheesecake
text:
Ingredients

Cheesecake

4 pkg cream cheese (softened)
¾ cups sugar
3 eggs
½ tsp vanilla extract
1 unbaked graham cracker pie crust (9″)



Sour Cream Topping

1 cup sour cream
½ cup sugar
½ tsp vanilla extract



Strawberry Topping

1 pkg frozen strawberries
2 tbsp cornstarch
½ cup sugar

title: Strawberry Cheesecake
text:
Instructions
Preheat the oven to 350°F.

Cheesecake

Combine the cream cheese, vanilla, and sugar and beat until smooth.
Add the eggs, one at a time, beating well after each.
Pour into the graham cracker crust.
Bake for 30 minutes. Cool for 10 minutes before adding the sour cream topping.



Sour Cream Topping

While the cheesecake bakes, mix the ingredients for the sour cream topping together until completely homogenous.
Pour on top of the cheesecake.
Bake for another 15 minutes.



Strawberry Topping

Mix all the ingredients together until homogenous.
Cook in the microwave or on the stove until thickened.
Spread the topping onto the cheesecake.
Chill completely before serving.

title: Blackened Catfish
text:
Serves: 4
Prep time: 5 minutes
Cook time: 10 minutes
Main
Simple, easy, delicious.

title: Blackened Catfish
text:
Ingredients

2 catfish filets
1½ tsp garlic salt
1½ tsp paprika
black pepper (to taste)

title: Blackened Catfish
text:
Instructions

Season fish to your liking on both sides. Use pepper generously.
Cook on medium-high heat in olive oil for approximately 3 minutes on each side, or until done. Cast iron skillet will produce the best results.

title: Butter Chicken
text:
Serves: 4
Prep time: 30 minutes
Cook time: 30 minutes
Main
Raleigh’s favorite meal of all time.

title: Butter Chicken
text:
Ingredients

Marinade

1½ lbs chicken thighs (1″ pieces)
¾ cup (145g) yogurt
2½ tsp (6g) chili powder
1 tsp (2g) turmeric
2 tsp lemon juice
1 tsp (2g) cumin
1 tbsp (7g) Garam masala
2 teaspoons (10g) fine sea salt
2-inch knob ginger



Curry Sauce

1 onion, thinly sliced
5 garlic cloves, chopped
1 tsp (2g) garam masala
1 tsp (2g) chili powder
½ tsp (1g) turmeric
½ tsp (1g) fenugreek
1 tbsp (13g) sugar
2 tbsp (28g) ghee
1 tbsp (15g) grated ginger
1 large can crushed tomatoes
¾ cup (177ml) heavy cream
2 tbsp (28g) unsalted butter
fresh cilantro for garnish
salt to taste

title: Butter Chicken
text:
Instructions
Requires >30 minutes of marination.

Place your chicken thighs in a bowl along with the rest of the marinade ingredients and mix thoroughly, ensuring the chicken gets completely coated with the marinade.
Cover with plastic wrap and reserve in the refrigerator.
Heat a 12″ nonstick skillet over medium-high heat and add the ghee.
Once melted, add your marinated chicken pieces and sear them on all sides until golden brown. It is okay if it does not get cooked all the way through.
Remove your chicken, place it in a large bowl, and reserve.
Add the onions, season with salt, and cook until just translucent.
Add the garlic and ginger and cook for another 30 seconds.
Stirring often, add the garam masala, chili powder, turmeric, fenugreek, and sugar.
Add in your crushed tomatoes and reduce for 2 minutes.
Place the onion mix in the blender and blend on high until smooth.
Place the sauce back in the pan, add your chicken, cover with a lid and simmer for seven minutes.
Add the heavy cream and simmer until thickened.
Cut the heat, stir in butter, and season with salt to taste.
Serve your chicken over rice, and garnished with cilantro.

title: Cheesy Bacon Chicken
text:
Serves: 4
Prep time: 15 minutes
Cook time: 40 minutes
Main
This is just sinful, but we can keep it between us.

title: Cheesy Bacon Chicken
text:
Ingredients

Cheddar cheese (slices & grated)
2 large chicken breasts
1 block cream cheese (softened)
1 can corn
1 jalapeño (chopped)
½ onion (chopped)
1 clove garlic (chopped)
6 strips bacon

title: Cheesy Bacon Chicken
text:
Instructions
Preheat oven to 375°F.

Cut several deep slits lengthwise into the chicken breasts.
Insert bacon and cheddar slices inside each slit.
Mix all other ingredients.
Cover chicken with mixture.
Bake for 40 minutes in a cast iron skillet.

title: Chicken Spaghetti
text:
Serves: 4
Prep time: 10 minutes
Cook time: 45 minutes
Main
Always a popular choice in our house.

title: Chicken Spaghetti
text:
Ingredients

1 package of spaghetti
3 chicken breasts
2 cups chicken broth
½ stick butter
1 buttermilk ranch packet
½ onion, diced
1 can Rotel tomatoes
1 can cream of chicken soup
garlic salt
black pepper
1 block cream cheese
⅓ block Velveeta® cheese

title: Chicken Spaghetti
text:
Instructions

Add all ingredients to the crock pot, excluding the cream cheese and Velveeta®.
Cook on high for 3½ hours.
Add cream cheese and Velveeta®, then cook an additional 30 minutes.
Shred and stir.
Boil the spaghetti to desired tenderness, strain, and add to the mixture in the crock pot.

title: Chili
text:
Serves: 4
Prep time: 5 minutes
Cook time: 2–4 hours
Main
Make this every fall.

title: Chili
text:
Ingredients

1 lb ground beef
1 onion
3 garlic cloves
2 jalapenos
1 can stewed tomatoes (16 oz.)
1 can tomato sauce (16 oz.)
3 tbsp chili powder (at least)
1 tbsp pepper
1 tbsp cumin
1 tbsp garlic salt
1 tsp paprika
¼ tsp coriander
2 tsp rosemary
2 cups water

title: Chili
text:
Instructions

Saute onion, garlic, and jalapenos with olive oil.
In a separate pan, brown the meat.
Once browned, drain the grease, and add to the sauteed vegetables.
Add all other ingredients.
Simmer for 2–4 hours.
Seasoning does not have to be exact, just add to your liking.

title: Chorizo Tacos with Plantains
text:
Serves: 4
Prep time: 15 minutes
Cook time: 30 minutes
Main
This one is worth the effort. I promise!

title: Chorizo Tacos with Plantains
text:
Ingredients

1 link of chorizo
1 plantain
1 lime (juice)
½ onion (diced)
½ onion (julienned)
1 bunch cilantro (chopped)
queso Oaxaca (or mozzarella)
6–8 corn tortillas
vegetable oil
¼ cup apple cider vinegar
hot sauce (like Cholula®)
Mexican lager (like Corona®) (or water)

title: Chorizo Tacos with Plantains
text:
Instructions

In a small container, add the apple cider vinegar, juice of half a lime, and the Julienned onions. Seal and shake briefly and set aside to pickle.
Shred the queso Oaxaca or mozzarella. You won’t need much.
Slice the plantain at a bias into ¼″ slices.
Heat a non-stick skillet over medium-high heat and add the chorizo. Cook until browned.
Remove the chorizo, and add the onions until translucent.
De-glaze with a ¼ cup of the lager (or water) until it boils off, then add back the chorizo.
Mix briefly, then set on the back burner.
In a large deep skillet add the oil so that it just covers the bottom and then some.
Once the oil is shimmering, add the plantain slices in batches, making sure not to overcrowd the pan.
Cook until one side is browned then flip. Once done, set aside.
Heat a non-stick skillet over medium heat until just smoking.
Add the tortillas, and cook both sides so that they are just slightly burned in a few spots.
Store in a bowl covered with a rag, or they will get stale.
Now plate. Add the tortillas, then the cheese. You can melt with a blowtorch or in the microwave. Add the chorizo, then 2–3 slices of plantains, then the pickled onions. Cut a few leaves of cilantro on top with scissors, and spritz with a quarter of lime. Optionally, top with a few dabs of hot sauce.

title: Catfish Tacos
text:
Serves: 4
Prep time: 10 minutes
Cook time: 10 minutes
Main
You can use any type of white fish for this recipe, but catfish makes it more relatable.

title: Catfish Tacos
text:
Ingredients

Fish

1 catfish filet
1 tbsp butter
1 tbsp olive oil
garlic salt (to taste)
black pepper (to taste)
cumin (to taste)
cayenne (to taste)
paprika (to taste)



Garnish

¼ onion (diced)
1 small tomato (diced)
fresh cilantro (chopped)

title: Catfish Tacos
text:
Instructions

Season the catfish on both sides.
Sear the catfish in olive oil over medium high heat, 4 minutes on each side.
Mix in the butter and baste for 1 minute.
Chop the catfish in the pan.
Serve on a corn tortilla and garnish with onion, tomato, and cilantro.

title: Lasagna
text:
Serves: 8
Prep time: 15 minutes
Cook time: 45 minutes
Main
The definition of Italian comfort food.

title: Lasagna
text:
Ingredients

Meat Sauce

1 lb ground beef
1 small onion (diced)
1 tbsp minced garlic
1 can mushrooms (diced)
1 can tomato sauce
1 can tomato paste
1 tsp oregano/Italian spices
salt (to taste)
black pepper (to taste)



Cheese Mixture

1 pack cheddar cheese (grated)
1 pack Swiss cheese (grated)
1 pack mozzarella (grated)
1 carton ricotta cheese



Extra

parmesan (for topping)
lasagna noodles

title: Lasagna
text:
Instructions
Preheat the oven to 350°F. Bring a large pot of water to boil if using traditional lasagna noodles.

Brown the meat with the onions, mushrooms, and garlic.
Add the tomato sauce and tomato paste.
Add the seasonings and mix completely.
Mix all the cheeses together in a separate bowl.
Boil the noodles following manufacturer’s specifications.
Add a layer of meat sauce, then noodles, then cheese. Repeat until complete.
Add a generous layer of parmesan on top.
Bake for 25 minutes.
Broil for the last 5 minutes for a nice browned top crust.

title: Mexican Corn Casserole
text:
Serves: 8
Prep time: 15 minutes
Cook time: 1 hour
Main Vegetarian
Use spicier chilis depending on your mood.

title: Mexican Corn Casserole
text:
Ingredients

4 eggs (beaten)
2 cans cream corn
1½ tsp garlic salt
1 cup corn meal
2 small cans mild chilis
½ lb cheddar (shredded)
1 tbsp oil
1 tsp salt

title: Mexican Corn Casserole
text:
Instructions
Preheat the oven to 350°F.

Mix the eggs, cream corn, oil, salt, garlic salt, and corn meal together.
Pour half of the mixture into a greased casserole dish.
Layer on the mild chilis and most of the cheddar.
Pour the remaining mixture on top.
Top with the remaining cheddar.
Bake for 1 hour.

title: Oven Swiss Steak
text:
Serves: 4
Prep time: 20 minutes
Cook time: 1 hour
Main
A classic enjoyed during harvest. Apparently the only thing little Boss included in his cookbook for Great Gran.

title: Oven Swiss Steak
text:
Ingredients

4 round steaks
2 carrots (chopped)
2 celery stalks (chopped)
½ onion (chopped)
1 can stewed tomatoes
1–2 cloves garlic (minced)
1 can cream of mushroom soup
beef broth (or water)
flour with favorite seasonings

title: Oven Swiss Steak
text:
Instructions
Preheat the oven to 350°F.

Coat the steaks evenly with the seasoned flour.
Add the steaks to a ripping hot pan and brown on each side in olive oil (about 5 minute each side).
Place in a Pyrex® dish.
Mix the fresh vegetables together and pour over the steaks.
Stir tomatoes and soup together and pour on steaks/veggies.
Add a little water or beef broth.
Cover with foil and bake about for about and hour.
Note: Boss likes to brown the steak in a cast iron skillet then transfer it to the oven.




This note is from the cover of a cookbook that Boss made for his Gran when he was young. The only recipe in the cookbook was oven Swiss steak.

title: Pork Katsu
text:
Serves: 4
Prep time: 20 minutes
Cook time: 10 minutes
Main
It’s deep-fried pork. What else needs to be said?

title: Pork Katsu
text:
Ingredients

4 boneless pork loin chops
salt to taste
1 pinch MSG
½ cup all-purpose flour
2 eggs plus a splash of water
1½ cups panko breadcrumbs
3–4 cups oil for frying

title: Pork Katsu
text:
Instructions

Cut the meat off the bone, and score the fat cap down, so the meat does not curl while cooking.
With a sharp knife, score the meat lightly, on the exposed flesh, in a crosshatch pattern, no more than ¼″ deep.
With a meat mallet, flatten the pork loin portions until they are ½″ thick; season with salt and a pinch of MSG.
Place in the fridge for 30 minutes or overnight.
Set up your breading station by placing the flour, beaten eggs and panko, in separate bowls.
Toss the meat in the flour, coating completely, and shake off the excess
Dip in the egg wash and let it drain slightly
Press it into the panko and make sure everything is well covered.
Repeat with all the chops.
Fill up a large pot with 2½″ of vegetable oil and heat to 340°F.
Fry the pork chops, one or two at a time for 4–6 minutes or until golden brown and crisp (>140°F internal).

title: Spaghetti-Stuffed Sandwiches
text:
Serves: 4
Prep time: 10 minutes
Cook time: 30 minutes
Main
As delicious as it is unhinged.

title: Spaghetti-Stuffed Sandwiches
text:
Ingredients

1 pound ground beef
1 can tomato sauce
2½ cups beef broth
16 oz spaghetti
Italian loaf bread
¼ cup butter
½ tbsp minced garlic (for compound butter)
1 tbsp minced garlic (for sauce)
garlic salt
black pepper
Italian seasoning

title: Spaghetti-Stuffed Sandwiches
text:
Instructions
Preheat the oven to a broil.

Cut the ends off of the Italian loaf bread and hollow them out.
Melt the butter, and add ½ tbsp of minced garlic, italian seasoning, and salt and pepper to the melted butter.
Use a brush to spread the butter mixture on the outside of the hollowed out Italian loaf, and set aside.
Brown the ground beef in a pot on high heat.
Add the tomato sauce, beef broth, 1 tbsp minced garlic, and seasonings, and stir.
Add the spaghetti, and cover the pot.
Cook on a simmer until spaghetti is done.
Stir every now and then to ensure it doesn’t stick.
Break up the pieces of spaghetti when you stir.
Put your Italian loaves under the broiler, cut-side-up, to toast them.
Stuff the hollowed out loafs with the spaghetti.

title: Spaghetti with Meatballs
text:
Serves: 4
Prep time: 30 minutes
Cook time: 40 minutes
Main
It’s different from the other recipe. I swear!

title: Spaghetti with Meatballs
text:
Ingredients

½ cup onion (chopped)
2 tbsp butter (melted)
1 can tomato paste (6 oz)
1 tbsp chopped fresh parsley
¼ tsp black pepper
dash of ground oregano
1 lb ground beef
2 tbsp onion (grated)
½ tsp salt
¼ tsp pepper
2 tbsp vegetable oil
spaghetti

title: Spaghetti with Meatballs
text:
Instructions
Prepare the meatballs before making the sauce.

Sauté the chopped onion in the butter in a large skillet.
Add tomatoes, parsley, black pepper, and oregano.
Cook over medium heat for 20 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Combine the ground beef, grated onion, salt, and black pepper.
Shape into 1½″ meatballs.
Cook in oil over medium heat until no longer pink; drain.
Add meatballs to the sauce.
Cook over low heat for 15 minutes.
Serve sauce over spaghetti.

title: Apricot Preserves
text:
Serves: 4
Prep time: 5 minutes
Cook time: 30 minutes
Preserve Vegetarian
Perfect pairing for white bread and peanut butter.

title: Apricot Preserves
text:
Ingredients

8 cups apricots (pitted/cut)
6 cups sugar
¼ cup lemon juice

title: Apricot Preserves
text:
Instructions

Put apricots and sugar in the instant pot.
Sauté on medium-high for 3 minutes.
Pressure cook on high for 1 minute.
Slow release for 10 minutes, then quick release.
Mash and stir on the sauté setting until thick but pourable (stirring every 5 minutes).

title: Dill Pickles
text:
Serves: 8
Prep time: 15 minutes
Pickle Vegetarian
You can put them on a sandwich, but I know you’ll just eat them out of the jar.

title: Dill Pickles
text:
Ingredients

cucumber (sliced or speared)
1 cup vinegar
1 cup water
2 tbsp sugar
1½ tbsp kosher salt
2 garlic bulbs (crushed)
1 bunch dill
black pepper (to taste)
crushed red pepper (optional)

title: Dill Pickles
text:
Instructions

Cut the cucumber to your desired shape.
Place the cucumber, garlic, dill, black pepper, and red pepper into a mason jar.
Boil the water, vinegar, and salt.
Pour the boiling liquid over the contents in the jar.
Seal the jar, and allow to cool before enjoying.

title: Japanese Curry
text:
Serves: 4
Prep time: 20 minutes
Cook time: 1 hour
Sauce Vegetarian
Try it with the pork katsu.

title: Japanese Curry
text:
Ingredients

¼ cup of butter (1st)
½ cup butter (2nd)
1½ tbsp butter (3rd)
3 onions (julienned)
1-quart chicken stock
4 dried shiitake mushroom
1 apple (peeled & grated)
1 tbsp tomato paste
½ cup all-purpose flour
1 tbsp garam masala
¼ cup curry powder
2 tsp MSG
1 tbsp soy sauce
2 tbsp Worcestershire sauce
1 tbsp honey or sugar

title: Japanese Curry
text:
Instructions

Add the 1st butter measurement to a large sauce-pot and melt over medium-high heat.
Add the julienned onions and cook for 30 to 45 minutes, stirring often, and adjusting the temperature between medium and low accordingly; if onions start to stick to the bottom, add a splash of water to de-glaze.
Bring 1 cup of the chicken stock to a boil and add the shitake mushrooms; after two minutes, remove your mushrooms or until entirely hydrated. Set aside.
Once the onions are a medium-dark color, add the grated apple and tomato paste to the onions. Stir and cook for 3–4 minutes or until the apple softens. Remove and place it aside.
Over medium-high heat (using the same pot), add the 2nd butter measurement.
Once melted, add the flour, constantly whisk for 30 seconds.
Add the garam masala (optional), curry powder, and MSG.
Whisk vigorously, and let toast for about 1 minute.
Add back the onions along with the soy sauce, Worcestershire sauce, honey (or sugar), and one quart of chicken shiitake stock, stirring often until thickened
Let simmer for 2 minutes.
Blend the mix until completely smooth, then add the 3rd butter measurement while blending.
Serve with rice and pork katsu.

title: Pan Gravy
text:
Serves: 4
Cook time: 10 minutes
Sauce
Perfect pairing for anything deep-fried.

title: Pan Gravy
text:
Ingredients

3 tbsp liquid fat
3 tbsp flour
1 cup meat stock or water
salt

title: Pan Gravy
text:
Instructions
Use the natural fats from whatever meat you’re cooking.

Remove meat from the pan and pour off the fat and measure the amount needed back into the pan.
Add the flour 1 tablespoon at a time, and whisk together constantly. Repeat until all the flour is used.
Cook over low heat, stirring steadily, until bubbly and brown.
Stir in the stock (or water), taking the pan off the heat to avoid lumps.
Boil 1 minute, scraping drippings off the bottom of the pan.
Season and serve.

title: Plum Preserves
text:
Serves: 4
Prep time: 5 minutes
Cook time: 30 minutes
Preserve Vegetarian
For when your plum tired of life.

title: Plum Preserves
text:
Ingredients

8 cups plums (pitted/cut)
4 cups sugar

title: Plum Preserves
text:
Instructions

Put plums and sugar in the instant pot.
Sauté for on medium-high for 3 minutes.
Pressure cook on high for 1 minute.
Slow release for 10 minutes, then quick release.
Mash and stir on the sauté setting until thick but pourable (stirring every 5 minutes).

title: Spaghetti Sauce
text:
Serves: 8
Prep time: 10 minutes
Cook time: 30 minutes
Sauce
Copied straight from Italy.

title: Spaghetti Sauce
text:
Ingredients

1 tbsp olive oil
1 lb Italian sausage
½ cup red wine
1 onion (diced)
2 cloves garlic (minced)
1 can fire roasted tomatoes
2 cans stewed tomatoes w/basil
1 cup tomato paste w/garlic
salt (to taste)
black pepper (to taste)
pasta water

title: Spaghetti Sauce
text:
Instructions
It helps to have pasta water made ahead. Otherwise just use regular water.

Heat the olive oil on medium-high heat and add the Italian sausage.
Cook until browned and a layer of fond has formed in the pan.
Remove the meat and add in the onion.
Sauté the onions until translucent.
Add the garlic and continue to sauté for another 30 seconds.
De-glaze the pan with the red wine. Simmer until slightly reduced.
Add in the tomato ingredients and season with salt and pepper.
Add back in the cooked italian sausage.
Simmer for at least 20 minutes.
Adjust the consistency with reserved pasta water.

title: Tex-Mex Enchilada Gravy
text:
Serves: 4
Prep time: 5 minutes
Cook time: 15 minutes
Sauce
White people can make it too!

title: Tex-Mex Enchilada Gravy
text:
Ingredients

¼ cup oil or butter
¼ cup all purpose flour
½ tsp ground black pepper
¾ tsp salt
2 tsp garlic powder
2 tsp ground cumin
½ tsp dried oregano
1 tbsp chili powder
2 cups beef broth
1 tbsp tomato paste

title: Tex-Mex Enchilada Gravy
text:
Instructions

Heat the oil or butter in a medium size skillet over medium heat.
Add in the flour and stir to mix. Will be a thick mixture.
Allow this to cook for just 1–2 minutes. The roux should be a very light brown.
Add in the spices. Stir to form a thick paste for no longer than 30 seconds.
Stir in the broth and tomato paste until smooth.
Continue to heat while stirring for several minutes until the sauce is slightly thickened.
Keep the heat to just below a simmer.
Pour into a jar to store or use to make enchiladas.

title: Carrots & Kale
text:
Serves: 4
Prep time: 15 minutes
Cook time: 15 minutes
Side Vegetarian
For the rabbits in the family.

title: Carrots & Kale
text:
Ingredients

3 large carrots (sliced)
1 bushel of kale (chopped)
1 onion (sliced)
2 tsp garlic salt
1 tsp lemon pepper
1 tbsp olive oil
1 tbsp butter

title: Carrots & Kale
text:
Instructions

Sear carrots in olive oil and butter for about 5 minutes.
Add the onion and continue searing with the lid on the pan, without stirring, until carrots are dark and caramelized.
Stir, then add chopped kale, turn off the burner, and cover until kale is wilted.
Add the seasonings to taste.

title: Deviled Eggs
text:
Serves: 3
Prep time: 15 minutes
Cook time: 15 minutes
Side Vegetarian
I’ve never seen anyone eat just one of these.

title: Deviled Eggs
text:
Ingredients

6 hard-boiled eggs
¼ cup mayonnaise
1½ tbsp sweet pickle relish
1 tsp mustard
⅛ tsp salt
dash of black pepper
sprinkle of paprika

title: Deviled Eggs
text:
Instructions
Pre-boil the eggs for 10–12 minutes and allow to cool completely.

Slice the eggs in half lengthwise and carefully remove the yolks.
Mash the yolks with the mayonnaise.
Add the relish, mustard, salt, and pepper; stir well.
Spoon the yolk mixture back into the egg whites.
Sprinkle with paprika.

title: Macaroni & Cheese
text:
Serves: 6
Prep time: 10 minutes
Cook time: 1 hour
Side Vegetarian
This is just a little bit better than Kraft.

title: Macaroni & Cheese
text:
Ingredients

1 package elbow macaroni
¼ cup butter
¼ cup all-purpose flour
2 cups milk
1 tsp salt
2 cups shredded cheddar
1 egg (beaten)
paprika

title: Macaroni & Cheese
text:
Instructions
Preheat the oven to 350°F. Bring water to boil beforehand.

Cook the macaroni according the the package directions, omitting salt.
Drain the pasta completely.
Melt the butter in a heavy saucepan over low heat.
Add flour, stirring until smooth.
Cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Gradually add the milk, cook over medium heat, stirring constantly until thickened and bubbly.
Stir in the salt and cheese until the cheese melts.
Gradually stir about ¼ of hot mixture into the egg.
Add the egg mixture back into the cheese mixture, stirring constantly.
Stir the macaroni into the cheese sauce.
Pour into a lightly greased 1¾ quart baking dish.
Sprinkle with paprika.
Bake for 35 minutes.

title: Stuffed Potatoes
text:
Serves: 6
Prep time: 5 minutes
Cook time: 45 minutes
Side
It’s cheesy potatoes. No need to question it.

title: Stuffed Potatoes
text:
Ingredients

6 Russet potatoes
1 stick butter
1 cup cheddar (shredded)
1 can mushrooms
green onions (chopped)
sour cream
fried bacon chips

title: Stuffed Potatoes
text:
Instructions

Boil the potatoes in the skins until tender.
Remove the skins and chop the potatoes into a large bowl.
Melt the butter into the potatoes.
Add in the cheese, mushrooms, bacon, and green onions.
Add sour cream while mixing until you are happy with the consistency.

title: White Rice
text:
Serves: 4
Prep time: 5 minutes
Cook time: 25 minutes
Side Vegetarian
Simple and goes with literally everything.

title: White Rice
text:
Ingredients

1 cup white rice
2 cups water
1 tsp Kosher salt

title: White Rice
text:
Instructions

In a fine mesh strainer add the rice.
Place the strainer into a bowl, and fill with water.
Mix the rice in the water and dispose of the water.
Repeat this process until the water no longer becomes cloudy.
Add the rice to a medium sauce-pot along with 2 cups of room temperature water and salt.
On the smallest burner, bring to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and cover.
Simmer for 20 minutes.

title: Chicken Enchilada Soup
text:
Serves: 4
Prep time: 15 minutes
Cook time: 1 minutes
Soup
This just might cure your cold.

title: Chicken Enchilada Soup
text:
Ingredients

2 tbsp olive oil
1 small onion (diced)
2 stalks celery (diced)
1 garlic clove (sliced)
1 can green chilis (4 oz)
1 can Rotel tomatoes
1 can beef broth (16 oz)
1 can chicken broth (16 oz)
1 can cream of chicken soup
1½ cups water
1 tbsp A1 steak sauce
¼ tsp pepper
2 tbsp Worcestershire sauce
1 tbsp cumin
1 tbsp chili powder
2–3 cups cooked white rice
1 rotisserie chicken (pulled)

title: Chicken Enchilada Soup
text:
Instructions
For cooked rice, see the recipe in the side dish section.

In a large pot, sauté the onion and garlic in olive oil.
Add all of the ingredients to the pot, excluding the rice.
Bring to a boil, then lower the heat and simmer for 1 hour.
Add the cooked rice, and serve.

title: Chicken Orzo Soup
text:
Serves: 4
Prep time: 20 minutes
Cook time: 45 minutes
Soup
Why fuss with rice, if you can just use orzo?

title: Chicken Orzo Soup
text:
Ingredients

1 tbsp olive oil
6 garlic cloves (minced)
1 yellow onion (diced)
2 carrots (thinly sliced)
2 celery stalks (chopped)
1 tbsp fresh ginger
1 tsp cayenne
1 tsp ground turmeric
6 cups chicken broth
1 lb chicken breast/thighs
1 tsp chopped rosemary
1 tsp chopped thyme
½ tsp salt
black pepper (to taste)
1 cup orzo pasta
⅔ cup frozen peas

title: Chicken Orzo Soup
text:
Instructions
Feel free to substitute with pre-cooked chicken.

Place a large dutch oven over medium high heat.
Add the olive oil once the pot is ripping hot and add in the chicken making sure not to crowd the pot.
Get a good sear on all sides of the chicken and save for later. There should be a nice fond in the pan at this point.
Add in the onion, carrots and celery.
Cook for a few minutes until the onion becomes translucent.
Add in the ginger, garlic, and turmeric and sauté for 30 seconds.
Add in chicken broth, chicken breast from earlier, and seasonings.
Bring soup to a boil then reduce heat to low and simmer until chicken is fully cooked.
Once chicken is cooked, remove and transfer to a cutting board to shred.
Add chicken back to the pot and stir in frozen peas and orzo.
Cook for another 7–8 minutes until orzo is just barely tender.

title: Tomato Soup
text:
Serves: 4
Prep time: 10 minutes
Cook time: 30 minutes
Soup
Of course you have to eat it with a grilled cheese!

title: Tomato Soup
text:
Ingredients

½ onion
6 tbsp butter
1 can diced tomatoes
1 can tomato sauce
¼ cup chicken broth
3 tbsp sugar
1 cup half & half
salt and pepper (to taste)
1½ tsp parsley
1½ tsp basil

title: Tomato Soup
text:
Instructions

Sauté onions in the butter.
Process the sauteed onions and diced tomatoes in a food processor.
Put back in the pot to mix with tomato sauce and chicken broth.
Bring soup to almost a simmer.
Add sugar, spices, and half & half.
